t: Where to Buy Pet Rats: A Trusted Guide
s: October 25, 2023 - It’s important when looking to get rats from breeders to make sure they have proper certifications and proper breeding practices. Don’t be afraid to ask plenty of questions of a potential breeder to ensure that they’re breeding safely and reputably. Questions to ask include when they will give you your baby rats (most breeders will only sell in pairs, and will sell around two weeks after weaning them from their mother, which is around 6 weeks of age), what kind of rat food the breeder gives the rats, and for photos of their cage set up.
